args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — the most recent release that was healthy in production. (Note: v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it was not eligible.) The rollback completed and was verified; no change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production.
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before attempting to redeploy it.
